text:
Samira Patel: Hey team — starting a 60% phased return next week. I paid for a backup morning nanny this month. Is there a way to get reimbursed while I'm on reduced hours?

Tess (People Ops): Hi Samira, yes we reimburse short-term childcare for approved phased returns. The subsidy is prorated by FTE. Please confirm your phased % and upload receipts. :slightly_smiling_face:

Samira Patel: 60% FTE confirmed. Receipt details below. Can we retroactively cover last month (I had no other options)?

Evan (Hiring Manager): I can confirm on record that Samira was approved for phased return and coverage dates. LM note will be attached once Samira drops the dates.

Samira Patel: Receipt snippet:
Vendor: Morning Helpers LLC
Service: backup nanny (weekday mornings)
Dates: 2026-05-03 to 2026-05-21
Amount: $560
Payment: CC 05/03 ref XYZ

Benefits Bot: Upload the vendor invoice + proof of payment + manager confirmation to Benefits Portal > Reimbursements. For retroactive requests we can approve up to 60 days back; anything older needs a People Ops exception. Tag case with "phased-return-childcare".

Noah (Payroll): Note: if you are located outside the US payroll will handle tax withholding differently. Please indicate country on the case. Also, reimbursements processed via code CHILDREM and can be split across pay cycles if requested.

Samira Patel: Can we split the $560 into two payments to avoid bumping taxable thresholds for this month? Prefer half now and half next payroll.

Tess (People Ops): Yes, we can request payroll to split. Include preferred split schedule in the case description. We will confirm with Payroll after docs are received.

Samira Patel: Uploaded: invoice.pdf, bank-screenshot.png, manager-note-evan.pdf. Case #PO-9821.

Evan (Hiring Manager): Manager note uploaded and confirms phased return approval from 2026-05-01.

Noah (Payroll): Case PO-9821 received. Estimated processing: first split payment 2026-05-21, second payment 2026-06-04. If international tax review required we will hold until clearance.

Samira Patel: Thanks all — quick and painless :)

Tess (People Ops): You're all set for now. If anything changes ping benefits and reference PO-9821.
